title: Phase 55K adds the DARPA and U.S. Government research collection
summary: Added a 23-document research collection with reviewed summaries, 23 Tier 1 source profiles, five synthesis signals, five organization records, one briefing, one dependency map, topic and source backlinks, and a downloadable archive containing 22 official captures plus one official-link record.
evidence_note: Every summary is tied to an official U.S. government source and includes explicit limits separating strategy, budget requests, and solicitations from appropriation, award, implementation, and outcome evidence.
